title: 第9章 反魔法这下麻烦大了第10章 不服换线
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 以太虹吸盾碎了。
深蓝色的光点在半空中炸开，散成漫天星屑。
一股无形的力量扫过车厢，里面的人都觉得胸口一闷，气血有些翻涌。
“殿下！”
阿卡什踉跄的站起来。
瑟薇娅抬起头看向洛加里斯。
男人嘴唇紧抿，手套上镶嵌的三颗宝石光芒暗淡了不少，明显为了挡住刚才那一击消耗不小。
“攻击来自我们看不到的地方。”洛加里斯冷冷的说。
“至少是六阶。”
瑟薇娅的呼吸停了一瞬。
六阶，在战场上，已经能左右一场小型战役的走向了。
她没有多想，立刻起身下令。
“以列车残骸为中心，建起防线，保护其他人撤到安全地方。”
“可是殿下……”
瑟薇娅打断了他：“这是命令！”
“接下来的战斗不是你们能插手的，别让我分心。”
阿卡什咬了咬牙，最后还是单膝跪下。
“遵命。”
他很快就带着剩下的卫兵，开始组织防线。
洛加里斯没说话，闭上眼睛，将自己的精神力如蛛网般朝四周悄然散开，试图捕捉那个狙击手的蛛丝马迹。一个六阶的敌人，不容小觑。
然而，就在他的感知延伸到极限的瞬间，一股并非来自远方山巅，而是近在咫尺的、冰冷刺骨的杀意陡然从他身后炸开！
洛加里斯猛地睁开双眼，根本来不及思考，身体的本能反应已经驱动了法术——【定点迁跃】！
银光一闪，他的身影瞬间消失在原地。几乎在同一时刻，两柄泛着不祥暗光的细长匕首无声地划过他刚才所站的位置，连空气似乎都被切开了无形的裂口。
十米开外，洛加里斯的身影重新出现，他回过头，瞳孔骤然收缩。
一个穿着繁复哥特式长裙的娇小少女正站在扭曲的车厢顶上，手里反握着那对险些将他“抹除”的匕首，脸上带着一丝没能得手的、孩子气的懊恼。
“哎呀，不愧是圣阿卡迪亚的天才教授，”她甜甜的声音响起，仿佛刚才那致命的偷袭只是一个无伤大雅的玩笑，“反应真快。”
少女笑眯眯地看着他，露出两颗小虎牙：“我叫莉莉丝，有人花大价钱，让我来请您……停在这里。”
“‘归零者’！”洛加里斯一字一顿地吐出这个在地下世界令所有施法者闻风丧胆的代号。掌握特殊术式“反魔法”的六阶强者，所有施法者的天敌。
“洛加里斯！”瑟薇娅的惊呼声传来。她显然也明白这个代号意味着什么。
她没有丝毫犹豫，双剑交错护在胸前，准备冲上车顶支援。
content_en:
The etheric siphon shield shattered.
Dark blue light spots exploded in mid-air, scattering into stardust all over the sky.
An invisible force swept across the carriage, and everyone inside felt a tightness in their chests and a surge of energy and blood.
"Your Highness!"
Akash stood up staggeringly.
Serviya raised her head and looked at Logaris.
The man's lips tightened, and the light of the three gems inlaid on the gloves dimmed a lot. It was obvious that he spent a lot of money to block the blow just now.
"The attack comes from a place we can't see." Logaris said coldly.
"At least level six."
Serviya's breathing stopped for a moment.
Level 6, on the battlefield, can already influence the direction of a small battle.
She didn't think much and immediately stood up and gave the order.
"With the train wreckage as the center, build a defense line to protect others and evacuate to a safe place."
"But Your Highness..."
Serviya interrupted him: "This is an order!"
"The next battle is not something you can interfere with. Don't distract me."
Akash gritted his teeth and finally knelt down on one knee.
"As commanded."
He quickly took the remaining guards and began to organize a defense line.
Logaris said nothing, closed his eyes, and quietly spread his mental power around like a spider web, trying to catch the sniper's clues. A sixth-level enemy should not be underestimated.
However, at the moment when his perception stretched to the limit, a cold and biting murderous intent that did not come from the distant mountaintop, but was very close at hand, suddenly exploded from behind him!
Logaris opened his eyes suddenly. He didn't even have time to think. His body's instinctive reaction had already driven the spell - [Fixed Point Jump]!
With a flash of silver light, his figure disappeared instantly. Almost at the same moment, two slender daggers glowing with an ominous dark light silently slashed across the spot where he had just stood, and even the air seemed to be cut with invisible rifts.
Ten meters away, Logaris' figure reappeared. He turned around and his pupils suddenly shrank.
A petite girl wearing a complicated Gothic dress was standing on the roof of the twisted car, holding the pair of daggers that almost "erased" him in her hands, with a trace of childish annoyance on her face as she failed to succeed.
"Oh, you are indeed a genius professor from Saint Arcadia," her sweet voice sounded, as if the fatal sneak attack just now was just a harmless joke, "The reaction is so fast."
The girl looked at him with a smile, showing two small tiger teeth: "My name is Lilith. Someone paid a lot of money to ask me to invite you...stop here."
"'Returner'!" Logaris spat out this codename that terrified all spellcasters in the underground world. A sixth-level expert who masters the special technique "anti-magic" and is the natural enemy of all spell casters.
"Logaris!" Serviya's exclamation came. She obviously also understands what this code name means.
Without any hesitation, she crossed her swords in front of her chest and prepared to rush to the roof of the car for support.
